name: esptool-git-frontend
description: esptool-js is consumed from its git reference and compiled from its TypeScript: it publishes no built output, so there is nothing to vendor. Naming it under web_modules.sourceDependencies routes it to vendor_sources, which fetches it and mounts it — the same treatment a file: path-dep gets. pako and atob-lite are ordinary registry deps, vendored prebuilt; esptool-js imports both.
